1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('world'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
const W=200,H=120,N=W*H;
const EMPTY=0,SAND=1,WATER=2,STONE=3,WOOD=4,FIRE=5,SEED=6,PLANT=7;
const mats=[
 {id:SAND,name:'Sand',color:'#e9bd67',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#f3d288,#c98c43)'},
 {id:WATER,name:'Water',color:'#51b9e8',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#7ce2f5,#3689df)'},
 {id:STONE,name:'Stone',color:'#8994a6',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#b2bdca,#606979)'},
 {id:WOOD,name:'Wood',color:'#aa7048',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#d49a60,#75432d)'},
 {id:FIRE,name:'Fire',color:'#ff754d',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe16d,#f34f48)'},
 {id:SEED,name:'Seed',color:'#92cc68',swatch:'linear-gradient(135deg,#d0e97a,#518e4b)'}
];
let cells=new Uint8Array(N),variation=new Uint8Array(N),age=new Uint8Array(N),processed=new Uint8Array(N);
let selected=SAND,brush=5,density=100,running=true,painting=false,erase=false,lastPoint=null,frame=0,particles=0,soundOn=false;
const image=ctx.createImageData(W,H),pixels=image.data;
const nameById=Object.fromEntries(mats.map(m=>[m.id,m.name]));
function index(x,y){return y*W+x} function inside(x,y){return x>=0&&x<W&&y>=0&&y<H}
function setCell(x,y,type){if(!inside(x,y))return;const i=index(x,y);cells[i]=type;variation[i]=Math.random()*32;age[i]=type===FIRE?12+Math.random()*18:0}
function swap(a,b){const t=cells[a];cells[a]=cells[b];cells[b]=t;let v=variation[a];variation[a]=variation[b];variation[b]=v;let ag=age[a];age[a]=age[b];age[b]=ag}
function clearWorld(){cells.fill(0);age.fill(0);particles=0;setScene('Untitled world')}
function setScene(name){document.getElementById('sceneName').textContent=name}
function countParticles(){let n=0;for(let i=0;i<N;i++)if(cells[i])n++;particles=n}
function paintAt(x,y,type=selected){const r=Math.max(1,Math.round(brush/2));for(let oy=-r;oy<=r;oy++)for(let ox=-r;ox<=r;ox++){if(ox*ox+oy*oy>r*r)continue;if(Math.random()*100>density)continue;const px=x+ox,py=y+oy;if(!inside(px,py))continue;setCell(px,py,erase?EMPTY:type)}}
function drawLine(a,b){if(!a){paintAt(b.x,b.y);return}const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,steps=Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy),1);for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){const t=i/steps;paintAt(Math.round(a.x+dx*t),Math.round(a.y+dy*t))}}
function moveDown(i,x,y,diagonal=true){if(y+1>=H)return false;const below=i+W;if(cells[below]===EMPTY){swap(i,below);return true}if(cells[below]===WATER&&cells[i]===SAND){swap(i,below);return true}if(diagonal){const d=Math.random()<.5?-1:1;for(const dx of [d,-d]){const nx=x+dx;if(!inside(nx,y+1))continue;const ni=index(nx,y+1);if(cells[ni]===EMPTY){swap(i,ni);return true}if(cells[ni]===WATER&&cells[i]===SAND){swap(i,ni);return true}}}return false}
function update(){processed.fill(0);frame++;const dir=frame%2?1:-1;
 for(let y=H-1;y>=0;y--){const start=dir===1?0:W-1,end=dir===1?W:-1;for(let x=start;x!==end;x+=dir){const i=index(x,y),type=cells[i];if(!type||processed[i])continue;processed[i]=1;
  if(type===SAND){if(moveDown(i,x,y))continue}
  else if(type===WATER){if(moveDown(i,x,y))continue;const d=Math.random()<.5?-1:1;if(inside(x+d,y)&&cells[index(x+d,y)]===EMPTY){swap(i,index(x+d,y));continue}if(Math.random()<.27&&inside(x-d,y)&&cells[index(x-d,y)]===EMPTY){swap(i,index(x-d,y));continue}}
  else if(type===SEED){if(moveDown(i,x,y))continue;let watered=false;for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){if(inside(x+dx,y+1)&&cells[index(x+dx,y+1)]===WATER)watered=true}if(watered&&Math.random()<.04){cells[i]=PLANT;variation[i]=Math.random()*20}}
  else if(type===FIRE){age[i]--;if(age[i]<=0||y===0&&Math.random()<.18){cells[i]=EMPTY;continue}for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){if(!dx&&!dy)continue;const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(!inside(nx,ny))continue;const ni=index(nx,ny);if((cells[ni]===WOOD||cells[ni]===PLANT)&&Math.random()<.055){cells[ni]=FIRE;age[ni]=13+Math.random()*20}}if(y>0&&Math.random()<.36){const ni=index(x,y-1);if(cells[ni]===EMPTY){swap(i,ni);continue}}}
  else if(type===PLANT){if(Math.random()<.025){const nx=x+(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),ny=y-1;if(inside(nx,ny)&&cells[index(nx,ny)]===EMPTY&&Math.random()<.5)setCell(nx,ny,PLANT)}}
 }}
}
function render(){let alive=0;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const t=cells[i],p=i*4;if(!t){pixels[p]=13;pixels[p+1]=17;pixels[p+2]=25;pixels[p+3]=255;continue}alive++;let color;
 switch(t){case SAND:color=[233,189,103];break;case WATER:color=[65,169,224];break;case STONE:color=[125,137,156];break;case WOOD:color=[158,99,59];break;case FIRE:color=age[i]>14?[255,130,56]:[255, seventy=0,45];break;case SEED:color=[143,190,89];break;case PLANT:color=[75,167,89];break;default:color=[255,255,255]}
 const shade=variation[i]||0;pixels[p]=Math.min(255,color[0]+shade-14);pixels[p+1]=Math.min(255,color[1]+shade-14);pixels[p+2]=Math.min(255,color[2]+shade-14);pixels[p+3]=255;
 }particles=alive;ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent=alive.toLocaleString()+' particles'}

Built a complete, playable 2D particle sandbox in `index.html`.

Draw with sand, water, stone, wood, fire, and seeds; try the Hourglass, Garden, Campfire, and Waterfall quick starts. It also includes brush size and flow controls, pause/step, erase, floor and rain tools, and responsive touch-friendly controls.

**Controls:** drag to draw, right-click to erase, Space to pause, and keys 1–6 to select a material. I assumed “sanbox” meant “sandbox.” Verified the page and interactions in Chromium.
